senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Januarius, name of a legendary Roman general who sacrificed his life to save his country.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:4">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> <he>הוה תמן … שמיה י׳ וכ׳</he> there was there (in Rome) an old man whose name was J., and who had twelve sons.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>בגין כן … קלנדס י׳</he> therefore they name it (that day) calendae Januariae. Cmp. <cite ref="J00405"><he>יַמְבְּרִיס</he></cite>.
